tasks.short: Advise students on curricula, careers and laboratory or field research.

steps.what: Understand the actual student's academic, career and field-research circumstances
inputs: actual student questions, experience and constraints

steps.what: Locate current curriculum requirements and relevant actual laboratory or field opportunities
inputs: checked actual student advising needs
actual current curriculum and opportunity records
outputs: checked relevant advising references and eligibility uncertainties

steps.what: Advise the actual student on academic, vocational and research choices
inputs: checked actual student advising needs
checked relevant advising references and eligibility uncertainties
outputs: actual advice, student choices and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned advising notes and retain the internal record
inputs: actual advice, student choices and unresolved questions

tasks.design: Configure actual curriculum and opportunity source links in {LMS}/{DOCS}. Keep student understanding, eligibility checks, actual advice and fresh assigned notes; ordinary internal saving stays ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current curriculum and field-opportunity references can require repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-source links reduce locating without choosing a student's route.
tasks.still_hard: Academic, personal and ethical fieldwork choices require actual dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes when an apparently suitable field opportunity conflicts with the student's real constraints.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current curriculum and opportunity links can reduce advising preparation navigation.

assumptions: Provisional reference20 removes three locating points, retaining17 relevance/eligibility checks. Actual curriculum/opportunity owners supply record revision, conditions and status; teacher verifies missing context manually. No automatic career recommendation or eligibility decision.

Actual advice45 includes brief capture; assigned fresh notes10 retain all writing/checking and ordinary saving. Remove/reweight notes if not actually owned. Existing links get zero credit; no invented application send or approval job.
unknowns: Which current sources are already linked for actual advising?
research_questions: Do references retain current field-opportunity conditions?

incremental.description: Maintain curriculum and opportunity source/status links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 reference-navigation points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: a new field-research route needs fresh eligibility investigation, leaving only0.7 familiar curriculum locating point removable, minus0.4=0.3. Actual student assessment, advice and fresh notes remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Initiate, facilitate and moderate classroom discussions.

steps.what: Choose actual classroom discussion questions, sources and facilitation approach
inputs: actual course objectives and current student context
outputs: chosen discussion questions and actual source context

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate and moderate actual discussion and capture assigned brief teaching observations
inputs: chosen discussion questions and actual source context
actual students and contributions
outputs: actual discussion and teacher-captured teaching observations

steps.what: Write actually assigned teaching follow-up from captured classroom observations
inputs: actual discussion and teacher-captured teaching observations

loop.purpose: Draft descriptive assigned teaching follow-up after the actual discussion
loop.input: actual teacher-captured observations and chosen follow-up points
loop.output: brief source-linked draft without student labels or inferred learning outcomes
loop.check: Teacher checks actual meaning, omitted disagreement, privacy and invented consensus or competence
loop.stop: Unclear observation or two failed revisions returns text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native teaching-note fields first; varied discussion qualifications need semantic drafting checks

steps.what: Complete and check actual follow-up and retain the ordinary internal teaching record
inputs: complete assigned discussion follow-up draft
actual discussion and teacher-captured teaching observations

tasks.design: Keep actual discussion preparation and live facilitation. Where the teacher actually owns written follow-up, draft only its descriptive prose in {DOCS} from real captured observations, retaining all teaching decisions and complete meaning checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assigned follow-up may repeat descriptive observations in prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded note-grounded drafting may remove a small amount of typing.
tasks.still_hard: Moderation, inclusion and interpretation of disagreement require actual teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher changes the discussion when a contribution reveals a serious misunderstanding.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in actually assigned follow-up typing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: captured teaching observations can support bounded descriptive follow-up drafting while facilitation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional follow-up10 removes only one descriptive typing point, retaining nine substantive writing/review points plus full final checks5. Actual brief observation capture is counted in live70, not a free recording or transcript. Teacher chooses actual follow-up points; no competence, emotion or consensus is inferred.

Follow-up is conditional on actual assignment; remove/reweight it and claim no such drafting benefit if absent. Native note fields first; existing drafting receives no credit. Ordinary save is fully retained without self-approval. No external student send or grade action is invented.
unknowns: Does the teacher actually own written discussion follow-up?
research_questions: Can descriptive drafts preserve disagreement without labeling students?

incremental.description: Check follow-up meaning and maintain permitted observation handling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1 descriptive typing point minus0.3 upkeep=0.7. Low: a contested discussion needs fresh careful wording and no routine descriptive typing can safely be removed; gross0 minus0.3 upkeep yields no net saving, floored0. Preparation, actual moderation, capture and full final checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver anthropology or archeology lectures.

steps.what: Choose research-method, urban-anthropology or language-and-culture lecture objectives and accurate examples
inputs: actual course objectives and learner needs
actual current sources and cultural context
outputs: chosen lecture objectives, examples and checked sources

steps.what: Prepare lectures by assembling selected current methods, diagrams and teaching sections
inputs: chosen lecture objectives, examples and checked sources
actual selected current lecture sections

steps.what: Check the complete lecture for current scholarship, source context and accurate representation
inputs: complete anthropology lecture draft
chosen lecture objectives, examples and checked sources

steps.what: Deliver actual undergraduate or graduate lectures and respond to real questions
inputs: checked saved final anthropology lecture
actual students and questions
outputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned lecture observations and subsequent teaching adjustments
inputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses

tasks.design: Configure selected current lecture-section reuse in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Retain cultural and scholarly choices, substantive adaptation, whole lecture checks, actual teaching and assigned fresh follow-up after delivery; ordinary saves stay ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable method diagrams and selected teaching sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native selected-section reuse reduces assembly without choosing cultural interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Responsible representation and explanation require the actual teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher corrects a generalization that misrepresents the community being discussed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected current teaching sections can be reused while scholarly interpretation and lecture delivery remain human.

assumptions: Provisional assembly25 removes seven repeated section/diagram assembly points, retaining18 adaptation points and full final checks10. Actual source/section owner supplies revision and scholarly context; teacher selects and verifies applicability and writes missing content manually. Existing section reuse gets zero credit.

Actual follow-up5 only if assigned, otherwise remove/reweight. Real learner observations arise after delivery40; no free earlier learning data. Ordinary saving has no self-gate or saving. No material send or grading action is invented.
unknowns: Which current sections are genuinely reusable?
research_questions: Does reused material preserve context and current scholarly qualifications?

incremental.description: Maintain lecture-section sources and scholarly/cultural context.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes7 selected assembly points minus0.6 upkeep=6.4. Low: a new language-and-culture case requires fresh examples and interpretation, leaving only2 stable research-method diagram points reusable, minus0.6=1.4. Selection, adaptation, full checks, delivery and real follow-up remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stay current through literature, colleagues and professional conferences.

steps.what: Locate current literature through actual journal and catalog subject views
inputs: actual scholarly interests and current research questions
actual journal/catalog entries and publication metadata
outputs: selected current reading sources with checked metadata

steps.what: Read and evaluate actual current anthropology and archeology literature
inputs: selected current reading sources with checked metadata
outputs: actual understanding and scholarly questions from reading

steps.what: Discuss actual field developments and unresolved scholarly questions with colleagues
inputs: actual understanding and scholarly questions from reading
actual colleague contributions
outputs: actual colleague discussion and new questions

steps.what: Participate in actual professional conferences and examine new work
inputs: actual conference sessions and participants

steps.what: Write and check actual personal scholarly notes and source references
inputs: actual understanding and scholarly questions from reading
actual colleague discussion and new questions
actual conference learning and exchanges

tasks.design: Configure native subject/date views in the actual scholarly catalog application, OTHER, linked to {DOCS} references. Keep actual reading, colleague discussion, conference participation and real notes; no generated summary substitutes for scholarly engagement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current subject/date searches can be set up repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved catalog views can reduce query navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Critical reading and scholarly exchange determine what new work means.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes a methodological challenge that a subject match does not reveal.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native subject/date catalog views can reduce repeated literature locating.

assumptions: Provisional search10 removes two repeated query/navigation points; actual catalog owner supplies publication metadata and teacher chooses subjects and validates relevance. Missing sources are investigated manually. No unmodeled automatic email alert, extraction or summary is proposed. Existing saved views get zero credit.

Actual reading40, discussion20 and participation25 remain. Personal notes5 retain actual writing/checking and ordinary ungated saving; remove/reweight if no such notes are owned. Conference notes depend on actual participation, not future inputs. No formal event report or send is invented.
unknowns: Which literature queries are still repeated manually?
research_questions: Do saved views preserve date coverage and avoid hiding contrary schools of thought?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated literature-query points minus0.3 upkeep=1.7. Low: an emerging theoretical topic needs new terminology and fresh source research, leaving only0.5 familiar catalog-navigation point removable, minus0.3=0.2. Reading, exchanges, conferences and actual notes remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
